content: SQLite backup methods: raw file copy unsafe on live DB and under WAL (recent commits live in -wal; copying only .db loses them). Online backup API (sqlite3_backup / .backup / better-sqlite3 db.backup()) gives consistent page-by-page snapshot of a live WAL DB without blocking. VACUUM INTO gives consistent compacted defragmented copy via single SQL statement. Both good for nightly; verify copy with PRAGMA integrity_check.
